verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public REST API end to end. It has API credentials with configurable permissions and expiry, plus a downloadable OpenAPI schema and Postman collection. Reference endpoints cover customers, monitoring, cases, audit trails, exports and transactions, and the docs also cover rate-limit headers, versioning, webhooks, sync/async and batch screening. A probe retrieved and parsed the OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, so the 404s at generic paths do not undermine it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of authenticated API operations actually working.
